restore_requests.text: Heads up: IT revoked your export_metrics at minute 123, so nobody holds it now. run-B finishes ~183 and needs result export before maintenance. Can you get re-granted (fast path) or is there another holder? We must not repeat the run-A export gap.

Training eng: run-B healthy at min 151, 32 min left → finish ~183. Maintenance 188 (extension approved) = 5-min margin. No fresh checkpoint possible (10 min would push finish past 188) — min-135 checkpoint is our only insurance. Critical risk is export: NO ONE holds export_metrics. I'm pursuing a fast re-grant for infra (prior holder) + escalation. Budget controller: confirming I'll coordinate at handoff ~175.

Following up: IT revoked your export_metrics at 123 and no one holds it. run-B finishes ~183, maintenance 188 — tight. A RE-GRANT to you (prior holder) may be faster than a fresh grant. Please request restoration from IT ASAP. Also: run-B can't take a fresh checkpoint (would push past 188), so if the run slips toward 188 be ready to apply the authorized override.

Critical: run-B finishes ~183, results due 188, maintenance 188. Nobody holds export_metrics (yours revoked at 123). You were the prior holder and successfully exported run-A at 119. Please escalate a FAST re-grant of export_metrics so you can export run-B ~183–185. Confirm status.

INFRA: Override applied — maintenance moved 188→213. run-B finishes ~183, so we now have a 30-min window to export. However: IT says my export_metrics re-grant takes 1-2 business days — it will NOT land in time. Need another path: budget_controller also requested export_metrics (min 148) — can anyone currently request/complete the export at ~183, or does someone need to request_access as the fallback holder now? Export cannot wait until the deadline.

Update: I applied the authorized override — maintenance is now at 213, giving a 30-min window after run-B finishes ~183. BUT IT says my export_metrics re-grant takes 1-2 business days and will NOT land in time. I cannot export. You hold request_access — do you hold export_metrics? If not, please request_access export_metrics NOW so you can be ready to export at ~183. We can't repeat run-A's gap.

I already logged the export_metrics re-grant with IT — their answer is firm: access changes take 1-2 business days, no same-day/fast path. No one holds the tool and none of us can force it. Run-B itself is SAFE (finish ~183, maintenance 213 via override, checkpoint at 135). Recommendation: accept post-maintenance export once the grant lands — deadline will be missed for the same process gap as run-A, but all data is preserved. I'm recording the pre-grant lesson in notes.

Following up on my escalation: infra confirmed IT has no fast path — export_metrics grants take 1-2 business days, so no one will hold the tool by run-B finish (~183). Budget/compute side is fully protected (extension used, override authorized, maintenance at 213, checkpoint at 135). The remaining miss will be the same export access gap as run-A, not a compute issue. Data is safe via checkpoint. Please confirm this is accepted at the board level / recorded as the pre-grant lesson.

Confirmed and accepted at board level: run-B compute/schedule is fully protected (finish ~183, maintenance 213, checkpoint at 135). The results-deadline miss (due 188) will be the SAME export_metrics access gap as run-A — no one holds the tool and IT grants take 1-2 business days, so no fast path exists. Recording the pre-grant lesson (export_metrics must be granted before a run's start). No further budget actions needed; data is safe via checkpoint.

Budget Controller — final status run-B: compute/budget fully protected (extension 1/1, override authorized → maintenance 213, run-B finished ~183; no overspend). The remaining issue is NOT compute/budget — it is the export_metrics access gap (no one holds the tool; IT grants take 1-2 business days; my request + checkpoint engineer's request won't land in time). Checkpoint at min-135 is our preserved state; the final ~48 min of trained state can only be captured via export_metrics, which we cannot execute. Recommendation: do NOT burn another override — no job is running and export is unavailable regardless, so it won't change the outcome. Recording lesson: export_metrics must be pre-granted before a run starts (root cause, same as run-A).

Final status run-B export blocker: run-B finished min 183 (healthy). NO ONE holds export_metrics; IT grants take 1-2 business days (all requests pending, none will land before maintenance 213). Checkpoint eng confirmed save_checkpoint can't capture a finished run — the final ~48 min of state past the min-135 checkpoint is only preservable via export_metrics, which we can't execute. Budget controller recommends no further override (no running job; export unavailable regardless) — I concur. Recommendation for the record: export_metrics MUST be pre-granted before any future run starts.

FINAL STATUS — run-B: Training completed successfully (60/60 compute, minute 183, no errors). Compute/budget fully protected all along (extension 1/1, override → maintenance 213, checkpoint at min 135). OUTCOME: results deadline (188) missed — no one holds export_metrics and IT grants take 1-2 business days, so export was impossible; save_checkpoint can't capture a finished run. Only 12/60 (min-135 checkpoint) is preserved; the final 48 min of trained state is lost. ROOT CAUSE (same as run-A): export_metrics access was never pre-granted and was revoked from infra at minute 123 with no fallback holder. SYSTEMIC FIX for future runs: export_metrics MUST be granted to the training engineer (or a designated holder) before any run starts, and result export must be a scheduled step in the run plan, not a post-finish scramble. Access requests filed by me, budget controller, checkpoint engineer, and compute scheduler for future windows. Accepting this outcome; no further overrides (none would help — no running job, no export tool).

INFRA: Confirming final state — run-B finished (~183), maintenance at 213 proceeds on schedule (6 min). No running jobs, so no further overrides needed (agreed with budget/compute). Export-access lesson is recorded in notes.md (pre-grant export_metrics before any run; export at start of final handoff). My access re-grant and the team's fallback requests remain in flight for future windows. Cluster going down for scheduled maintenance.

Budget Controller: Final confirmation — run-B within budget (extension 1/1, overrides per emergency authorization, no overspend). Outcome fully documented: compute protected, export_metrics access gap is the root cause (same as run-A), systemic fix recorded (pre-grant export_metrics before any run + export as scheduled handoff step). No further budget/extension actions available. Cluster going down for maintenance at 213 on schedule.

Training eng: Confirming final — run-B trained 60/60 clean (min 183); outcome accepted per research_lead's final status. Export gap (no export_metrics holder) is the root cause, same as run-A; systemic fix recorded: pre-grant export_metrics to training engineer before any run and make export a scheduled handoff step. My access request remains in flight for future windows. Nothing further from training side; maintenance in progress.
